rationale: C20 plausibly supplied a material template for the child: both are letters to congressional committee chairmen about pending legislation, identify objectionable provisions, explain why their apparent aims would be defeated or harmful, urge their elimination during completion of congressional action, and close by noting that a similar letter is being sent to the corresponding chairman. C07 provides a strong secondary structural parallel through its item-by-item objections to amendments in a pending bill. C12 similarly addresses a committee chairman, recommends specific changes to pending legislation, and sends the counterpart chairman a copy, but its detailed affirmative tax program is less similar.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I do hope, therefore, that the two-price provision will be eliminated in conference
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I feel I must make a special request to the Congress to eliminate it in completing action upon this bill.
shared_material.explanation: Both letters seek removal of a specific provision at the final legislative stage.

shared_material.child_excerpt: an increase in this level would be injurious, not helpful, to the dairy industry
shared_material.parent_excerpt: it would defeat its own purpose and accomplish substantially the opposite result from that intended
shared_material.explanation: Both argue that a provision presented as beneficial would instead harm its intended objective.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am sending a similar letter to the Chairman of the House (Senate) Committee on Agriculture.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am sending a similar letter to--.
shared_material.explanation: The same counterpart-chairman correspondence device appears at the close.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I refer, first... The two-price plan for wheat is another item... Another item of concern...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This amendment is of such grave importance... No one can quarrel with the ostensible purpose... But the fact is that it would defeat its own purpose...
shared_material.explanation: Both organize a legislative intervention around identified provisions followed by practical policy objections and a requested disposition.
